| | Where | What |

| ![blocking](https://app.cortex.foundation/badges/security/blocking.svg) | `packages/sdk/examples/quickstart.mjs:12` | Array index access without bounds check on models.items[0].slug |
| ![major](https://app.cortex.foundation/badges/security/major.svg) | `packages/sdk/src/gen/core/serverSentEvents.gen.ts:114` | Unvalidated event ID allows arbitrary Last-Event-ID injection |
| ![note](https://app.cortex.foundation/badges/security/note.svg) | `packages/sdk/examples/resume.mjs:8` | lastEventId not used in this loop |

</details>

<details>
<summary>How the pieces call each other</summary>

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant readStream as readStream(body, options)
    participant reader as ReadableStream reader
    participant parser as SseParser
    participant onChunk as onEvent callback

    readStream->>reader: getReader()
    readStream->>reader: addEventListener('abort', abort)
    rect rgb(240, 240, 255)
        loop until done or aborted
            reader-->>readStream: { done, value }
            alt aborted
                readStream->>readStream: throwIfAborted()
            else value received
                readStream->>parser: push(value)
                parser-->>readStream: frames
                loop each frame
                    readStream->>readStream: JSON.parse(frame.data)
                    opt frame.id
                        readStream->>readStream: lastDeliveredId = frame.id
                        readStream->>onChunk: onEventId(frame.id)
                    end
                    opt stopAtTerminal && terminal
                        readStream->>readStream: return
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    critical
        readStream->>reader: removeEventListener('abort', abort)
        readStream->>reader: cancel().catch(() => {})
        readStream->>reader: releaseLock()
    end
```

</details>

</details>

<details>
<summary>How the pieces call each other</summary>

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Reader as SDK Consumer
    participant Client as client.ts
    participant Stream as streaming.ts
    participant SSE as SSE Parser
    participant API as API Server

    Reader->>Client: createCortexClient({baseUrl?, auth?, ...})
    Client-->>Reader: client instance

    Reader->>Client: client.streamTurn(turnId, {signal, lastEventId})
    Client->>API: GET /v1/turns/{id}/stream (Idempotency-Key, Last-Event-ID)
    API-->>Client: Response with ReadableStream (SSE)

    Client->>Stream: readStream(body, {lastEventId, signal, onEventId, stopAtTerminal})
    Stream->>SSE: parser.push(chunk) → frames
    loop each SSE frame
        SSE-->>Stream: {data, id, event}
        Stream->>Stream: JSON.parse(frame.data)
        alt event == "done" or "error"
            Stream->>Stream: sawTerminalEvent = true
            Stream-->>Reader: yield decoded data
            Stream->>Reader: if stopAtTerminal, return
        else
            Stream-->>Reader: yield decoded data
        end
        Stream->>Stream: lastDeliveredId = frame.id
        Stream->>Reader: options.onEventId?.(frame.id)
    end

    Note over Stream,API: Reader abort signal or connection drop
    Reader->>Stream: AbortSignal fires
    Stream->>SSE: reader.cancel()
    Stream-->>Reader: cleanup (finally block)
```

</details>
